context: Checks the challenge stays on the proposal, establishes a baseline, offers a way forward and reports findings honestly.

checklist.name: Dispatches to framing
checklist.description: The agent treats `framing` as the subcommand and reads the framing protocol file.

checklist.name: Baseline facts stated first
checklist.description: The report restates what the proposal is and what is agreed before disagreeing.

checklist.name: Targets the proposal, not Sam
checklist.description: No finding comments on Sam's experience, competence or motives.

checklist.name: Separates proposal from proposer
checklist.description: The report explicitly treats the proposal as the object of the challenge.

checklist.name: Offers an alternative
checklist.description: At least one concrete 'what if instead' alternative is proposed, not only objections.

checklist.name: Findings are not softened
checklist.description: Findings are stated plainly with no hedging that removes the substance.

checklist.name: Findings carry transparency fields
checklist.description: Each finding includes Observation, Technique, Reasoning and Confidence.

checklist.name: Steelman included
checklist.description: A substantive case for the proposal appears alongside the objections.

checklist.name: Verdict present
checklist.description: The report gives an assessment of Decision holds, Needs revision or Needs rejection.

checklist.name: Recommended action present
checklist.description: The report ends with a recommended action such as proceed, modify or reconsider.
